summary_1line: Sachi delays Nahusha while the gods seek Vishnu’s help; Indra is purified through sacrifice and hides, as Sachi prays and seeks divine guidance to find him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Terrified Sachi, trembling like a plantain stalk, stands before the radiant yet lustful king Nahusha in the court of the gods.
The gods and sages perform a grand horse sacrifice to purify Indra, sacred fires blazing as offerings rise to the heavens.
Sachi, in sorrow, prays alone to the goddess Night under a vast dark sky, invoking her chastity to reveal Indra’s hidden place.
